acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves the local decision-workbench experience and governed interaction boundaries; it does not approve a product direction or execute AgentFlow.
evidenceRequired: Fresh desktop/mobile evidence covers success, blocked, stale, invalid, recovery, loading, empty, and error states.
Keyboard, focus, names, announcements, reduced motion, contrast, target size, zoom, and reflow checks are recorded.

completionCriteria: The Operator Shell provides progressively disclosed preparation and review views for authority capsule, UX state coverage, counterfactual comparison, arena evidence, outcome assessment, AgentFlow handoff, and receipt audit.
Every view shows current status, evidence boundary, unknowns, governing authority, human next action, and AgentFlow ownership where execution is involved.
No route starts AgentFlow, selects a design winner, adopts a canonical backlog, promotes memory, or mutates a baseline implicitly.

The active workflow step exposes aria-current, completed steps expose non-color state text, conditional requiredness is programmatic, and revealed results receive deliberate announcement and focus handling.
Validation findings appear as a concise, actionable human-readable list before any optional raw JSON evidence payload.
Reduced-motion preference disables scripted smooth scrolling, prerequisite-disabled and busy states are distinct, and essential operational metadata is at least a 12px equivalent.

At 320px through wide desktop, every workflow is discoverable and keyboard reachable without depending on a subtle horizontal scrollbar, selection stays visible, and the dominant action plus gate/write state remain easy to find.
At 200 percent zoom, evidence key/value rows, path fields, authority copy, and step labels reflow without clipped values or two-dimensional panning.
The shell uses the ratified Proofloom palette and typography with near-flat elevation, no second token system, and no weakened accessibility or quality thresholds.
Fresh desktop and mobile evidence covers success, blocked, stale, invalid, recovery, loading, empty, and error states.
nonObjectives: Do not turn the shell into an arbitrary terminal or AgentFlow execution console.
Do not expose raw JSON as the primary interaction model.
Do not create a second component system, token system, backlog, or E2E hierarchy.
objective: Turn the Proofloom Launchpad into a coherent, accessible decision workbench without transferring execution or approval authority to the interface.
title: Build the governed operator decision workbench
